description: Default destination for paper-convention aligned runs with J = h = 1 and T in {1, 2}.
sign_convention: Paper convention: rx = -h and rzz = -J, so rxT = -h*T and rzzT = -J*T.
notes: This directory is prepared for new aligned tensor-network runs.
The batch config maps rxT/rzzT into h/J at runtime using h = -rxT/T and J = -rzzT/T.
